name: Healthcare
title: Data and AI for Healthcare
description: Data platforms and forecasting for hospitals and healthcare providers: patient, clinical and operational data in one trusted model.
intro: We bring hospital data spread across departments and systems into one trusted model, then use it to plan ahead, such as forecasting the beds and staff each unit will need. Without it, every team keeps its own numbers.
problems: Patient, clinical and operational data sit in separate systems and spreadsheets, so leadership can’t compare departments side by side.
Each team reports from its own copy, so the numbers rarely match.
Proving who can see which data, for a compliance audit, is close to impossible.
Seasonal disease outbreaks are handled after the fact: beds and staff are added only once wards are already full.

name: Insurance
title: Data and AI for Insurance
description: Data integration and AI for insurance and claims teams: claims linked to the records behind them, so reviewers see what doesn’t add up before payout.
intro: We link claims to the records behind them, so reviewers can spot the ones that need a closer look before money goes out. When claims are checked by hand, it’s hard to see which ones don’t add up.
problems: Every claim is checked by hand, one at a time.
Reviewers have no quick way to see whether an expensive test or procedure matches the doctor’s prescription or the patient’s history.
Claims that don’t add up are often paid anyway.

name: Automotive
title: Data and AI for Automotive
description: Data integration for automotive businesses: dealer and inventory feeds in different formats, cleaned into one model and kept up to date.
intro: We clean dealer and inventory feeds into one model, so your listings stay accurate without manual fixes. That data often arrives in many different formats, which makes accurate listings hard to keep.
problems: Every dealer sends stock differently: a web link, a file uploaded to an SFTP server, or files that have to be collected from the dealer’s own server.
Each feed uses its own column names, and key details like registration dates are often missing.
Onboarding a new dealer is slow and messy.
Keeping listings on Google accurate gets harder as the dealer list grows.

name: Finance
title: Data and AI for Finance
description: Data platforms for finance teams on Microsoft Fabric: payroll, timecards and finance data in one model, without spreadsheet matching.
intro: We bring payroll, timecards and finance data into one model, so the numbers line up without spreadsheet work. Without it, finance teams spend hours matching spreadsheets from different systems before they can answer a simple question.
problems: Payroll exports, timecards and finance data arrive as messy files and separate reports.
Matching labor cost to finance takes hours of manual spreadsheet work.
Changes go straight to production with no testing.
